title: Action confirmation
description: An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send, delete, pay, run a command): what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; the outcome replaces the buttons once decided.
when: Human-in-the-loop: any agent action that is outward-facing, costs money or cannot be undone.
a11y: A labelled group; buttons say what they do (approveLabel “Gửi 3 email”); danger makes the approve button red for actions that cannot be undone.
notes: Keep it in the conversation after the decision (state) so the log shows who allowed what.
